vBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2341: Advancing ceiling permanently jams when review/test agents can't POST verdicts (self-heal via boot+patrol journal reconcile, zombie reap, orphan re-dispatch)

plan.title: Advancing ceiling permanently jams when review/test agents can't POST verdicts (no journal reconcile / zombie reap on boot)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: A transient status-POST server bug turns into a PERMANENT advancing-ceiling deadlock. When a review/test agent's verdict POST fails, the verdict survives only in the workspace journal (<workspace>/.pan/records/<issue>.json or .pan/test/result.json); the DB review_status row stays at reviewing/testing. Five defects combine: (1) the terminal-advancing reaper is disabled by KEEP_SPECIALIST_SESSIONS_ALIVE=true (PAN-2007, operator keep-alive), so completed sessions never free their ceiling slots; (2) there is no advancing-session reaper for merged issues (checkMergedWorkSessions only reaps the work session); (3) nothing systematically triggers the existing getReviewStatusSync journal->DB reconcile (PAN-1988) for in-flight issues, so a journaled-but-unposted verdict is invisible to the raw-DB patrol readers; (4) the advancing ceiling is counted from the SQLite agents table (countRunningAgents -> countAgentsByStatus('running')), NOT from tmux, so killSession alone does NOT free a slot until the agent row is flipped to stopped; (5) an agent that dies mid-stage with no recorded verdict leaves review_status stuck reviewing/testing with no live specialist and no journal-aware re-dispatch. Result (2026-07-03): 9/9 advancing slots held by done agents (2 merged, 7 non-merged-terminal), pipeline frozen for hours until a redeploy + manual tmux kill-session.
narratives.Proposal: Self-heal on boot and every patrol, KEEPING the operator's PAN-2007 KEEP_SPECIALIST_SESSIONS_ALIVE=true (operator decision 2026-07-07). (1) Add reconcileInFlightJournals(): enumerate in-flight issues (union of non-merged review_status rows and issues of alive advancing-role agents) and call getReviewStatusSync() on each, driving the existing reconcile/handoff/feedback/test-recovery; plus a markAdvancingSessionStopped() helper. (2) Add checkMergedAdvancingSessions(): reap merged issues' advancing sessions (bypass flag) + mark the rows stopped. (3) Add checkIdleTerminalAdvancingSessions(): reap NON-merged terminal advancing sessions only after the pane is idle >= 10 min (the issue's 'idle past a short timeout' path — frees the ~7/9 zombie class without flipping the flag) + mark stopped. (4) Make orphan re-dispatch (recoverStalledReviewConvoys, reconcileReviewStatusOrphan) reconcile the journal first: skip re-dispatch when terminal, re-dispatch only an in-progress stage with no live agent and no verdict. (5) Wire the sweep + both reapers into startDeacon so a restart self-heals. (6) An end-to-end regression test. Every reaper flips the reaped agents-table row to stopped so the DB-based count frees the slot the same cycle.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT flip KEEP_SPECIALIST_SESSIONS_ALIVE to false; the operator chose to keep it (PAN-2007 owns that switch).
- Do NOT fix the underlying broken status-POST route that triggered the incident; the self-heal must survive it.
- Do NOT add a new review verdict artifact analogous to .pan/test/result.json; the per-issue journal already serves that role.
- Do NOT change the advancing ceiling cap or the max_work_agents / reserved_advancing_slots config.
- Do NOT reuse reconcileAgentLiveness() to free reaped advancing slots (it auto-resumes stopped work agents); use the targeted markAdvancingSessionStopped instead.
- Do NOT add a competing reaper in the dashboard host process (single-Deacon invariant); reaping stays in the deacon.
- Do NOT add browser/Playwright verification; backend-only.
- Do NOT change work-lane reaping beyond the existing PAN-1726/PAN-1730 behavior.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep KEEP_SPECIALIST_SESSIONS_ALIVE=true; free non-merged terminal zombies via an idle-timeout-gated reaper instead of flipping the flag.
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator explicitly chose the superset-keep-flag option (2026-07-07). The idle gate implements the issue's own 'idle past a short timeout' suggestion, preserving PAN-2007 operator inspection while still self-healing.

autoDecisions.summary: Reconcile via the existing getReviewStatusSync read path, invoked systematically over in-flight issues, rather than a new bespoke reconcile.
autoDecisions.rationale: getReviewStatusSync already reconciles journal->DB, re-emits handoffs, delivers feedback, and recovers test artifacts (PAN-1988). Duplicating it would violate single-source-of-truth; the fix is to invoke it.

autoDecisions.summary: Every reaper flips the reaped agents-table row to status='stopped' (getAgentStateSync -> markAgentStoppedState -> saveAgentStateSync) after killSession.
autoDecisions.rationale: The advancing count reads the SQLite agents table, not tmux, so killSession alone does not free the slot. Marking stopped meets the 'within one patrol cycle' bar and fixes a latent bug the prior narrow PRD missed.

autoDecisions.summary: TERMINAL_ADVANCING_IDLE_REAP_MS default = 10 minutes, mirroring PAN-1730's AWAITING_TEST_IDLE_REAP_MS.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses an established, reviewed idle-gate convention; long enough to preserve brief operator inspection, short enough to prevent a permanent jam.

items.title: Add reconcileInFlightJournals() sweep + markAdvancingSessionStopped() helper; wire sweep into the patrol

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/advancing-selfheal.ts exporting (a) reconcileInFlightJournals(): string[] — enumerate the union of loadReviewStatuses() rows with mergeStatus !== 'merged' and not closed/completed, plus issueIds parsed from tmux-alive advancing-role agents (agent-<issue>-<role>); skip states outside {pending,reviewing,passed,failed,blocked,testing,dispatch_failed}; for each unique issueId call getReviewStatusSync(issueId) in a try/catch to drive the PAN-1988 reconcile; return one action per issue whose row advanced. And (b) markAdvancingSessionStopped(session): boolean — getAgentStateSync(session); no-op (return false) if absent or already stopped; else saveAgentStateSync(markAgentStoppedState(state)) and return true (markAgentStoppedState is src/lib/agents/agent-state.ts:662). Wire reconcileInFlightJournals() into runPatrol() (deacon.ts) early — after resetPatrolDispatchBudget()/checkStuckAgentRemediation and BEFORE checkTerminalAdvancingSessions() (~deacon.ts:2763). Boot wiring is a later bead.

items.title: Given an in-flight issue whose journal holds a terminal verdict newer than the DB, when reconcileInFlightJournals() runs, then it calls getReviewStatusSync and the review_status DB row is reconciled to the journaled verdict

Given a tmux-alive advancing-role agent whose issue has no review_status DB row, when the sweep runs, then it enumerates that issueId and calls getReviewStatusSync for it; and given a merged/closed/completed issue, then it skips that issue

Given an agents row already at status='stopped', when markAdvancingSessionStopped(session) is called, then it returns false and writes nothing; given a 'running' row, then it flips the row to stopped and returns true

Given a journaled terminal verdict on an alive advancing session, when one patrol cycle runs, then the sweep reconciles the verdict to the DB and the reaper frees the slot in the SAME cycle (proving the sweep runs before the reaper)
Add checkMergedAdvancingSessions() reaper for merged issues + mark rows stopped; wire into patrol

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cloister/deacon.ts add checkMergedAdvancingSessions(): Promise<string[]> as a sibling of checkMergedWorkSessions (~:2514). For each review_status with mergeStatus === 'merged', collect sessionsToReapForRole(issueId, role, alive) for role in {review,test,ship} (add sessionsToReapForRole to the existing reap-terminal-sessions.js import). For each session: killSession(session) tolerating 'already gone', THEN markAdvancingSessionStopped(session) (imported from advancing-selfheal.js). Bypasses KEEP_SPECIALIST_SESSIONS_ALIVE. Wire into runPatrol immediately after the checkMergedWorkSessions() block (~:2770). loadReviewStatuses, listSessionNames, killSession, logDeaconEventSync, Effect are already imported.

items.title: Given 9 alive advancing sessions all for merged issues at ceiling 9, when checkMergedAdvancingSessions() runs, then it reaps all 9, marks their agents rows stopped, and canDispatchAdvancing() returns true
Given an advancing session for a non-merged issue, when checkMergedAdvancingSessions() runs, then it does not reap that session
When checkMergedAdvancingSessions() runs a second time on the same already-reaped issues, then it produces no additional reap actions and does not throw (idempotent)

Given KEEP_SPECIALIST_SESSIONS_ALIVE=true and a merged issue's alive advancing session, when a patrol cycle runs, then checkMergedAdvancingSessions() reaps that session (the reap bypasses the keep-alive flag)
Add checkIdleTerminalAdvancingSessions() for non-merged terminal zombies (idle-gated) + mark stopped; wire into patrol

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cloister/deacon.ts add const TERMINAL_ADVANCING_IDLE_REAP_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000 and checkIdleTerminalAdvancingSessions(): Promise<string[]> as a sibling of checkAwaitingTestWorkSessions (~:2564), mirroring its idle-gate pattern. For each review_status with mergeStatus !== 'merged' and isRoleTerminal(role, status) for an advancing role, take sessionsToReapForRole(issueId, role, alive); for each session read getAgentRuntimeStateSync(session) and proceed ONLY when runtime.state === 'idle' and now - Date.parse(runtime.lastActivity) >= TERMINAL_ADVANCING_IDLE_REAP_MS; then killSession(session) + markAdvancingSessionStopped(session). Bypasses KEEP_SPECIALIST_SESSIONS_ALIVE only via the idle gate. Wire into runPatrol right after the merged-advancing-reaper block. Restate and follow the repo fake-timers rule in the test.

items.title: Given a non-merged advancing session whose verdict is terminal and whose pane is idle >= 10 min, when checkIdleTerminalAdvancingSessions() runs, then it reaps the session and marks the agents row stopped
Given the same terminal session idle < 10 min, when the reaper runs, then it does not reap it (idle gate preserves operator inspection)
Given a non-merged advancing session whose verdict is NOT terminal, when the reaper runs, then it does not reap it

Given the pane crosses the 10-minute idle threshold (virtual time advanced via fake timers), when the reaper runs, then it reaps the terminal session past the threshold and leaves it untouched before the threshold
Make orphan re-dispatch reconcile the journal before re-dispatching a stalled review/test stage

narrative.Action: In recoverStalledReviewConvoys (deacon-review-status.ts:638) and reconcileReviewStatusOrphan (deacon-review-status.ts:429), obtain journal-reconciled status via getReviewStatusSync(issueId) before deciding, rather than trusting the raw loadReviewStatuses() row. If the reconciled verdict is terminal (review passed/blocked/failed, or test passed/failed) skip re-dispatch — the reapers free the slot. Only re-dispatch a stage genuinely in-progress (reviewing/pending, or testing/dispatch_failed) with no live specialist AND no journaled verdict. Preserve the existing liveness gate (reviewConvoyLiveness for review), the attempt/cooldown budget, and the tryReserveAdvancingSlot() ceiling guard.

items.title: Given review_status='reviewing' with no live convoy but a journaled 'blocked' verdict, when recoverStalledReviewConvoys runs, then it reconciles the verdict to the DB and does NOT spawn a fresh review
Given review_status='reviewing' with no live convoy and no journaled verdict, when recoverStalledReviewConvoys runs, then it re-dispatches the review stage
Given testStatus='testing' with no live test agent but a written/journaled 'passed' verdict, when reconcileReviewStatusOrphan runs, then it reconciles the verdict and does NOT re-dispatch test
Given testStatus='testing' with no live test agent and no verdict, when reconcileReviewStatusOrphan runs, then it re-dispatches the test stage
Run the reconcile sweep and both advancing reapers at deacon startup before the first dispatch

narrative.Action: In startDeacon() (src/lib/cloister/deacon.ts ~:3371), between reconcileAgentLiveness() and runScheduledPatrol('startup'), insert an ordered, guarded, idempotent boot self-heal: reconcileInFlightJournals() -> checkMergedAdvancingSessions() -> checkIdleTerminalAdvancingSessions(), each in its own try/catch, logging via logDeaconEventSync, so a restart into a jammed ceiling frees advancing slots before the first dispatch. Single deacon owner — do NOT add a competing reaper in the dashboard host process (single-Deacon invariant).

items.title: On startDeacon, the boot self-heal reconciles journaled verdicts then reaps merged and idle-terminal advancing sessions before runScheduledPatrol('startup') (asserted order)

Given a boot where a non-merged advancing session's journal holds a terminal verdict and the pane is idle >= 10 min, when the boot self-heal runs, then it reconciles the DB and frees the slot by marking the reaped row stopped
When the boot self-heal runs twice in succession, then the second run produces no additional reap actions (idempotent)
End-to-end regression test for the kill-POST self-heal and dead-mid-stage re-dispatch

narrative.Action: Add src/lib/cloister/__tests__/pan-2341-ceiling-selfheal.test.ts mirroring the issue acceptance. Scenario 1: an advancing review session alive with its agents row 'running', journal holds terminal 'passed'/'blocked', DB review_status reads 'reviewing' (POST failed), pane idle >= 10 min. Run one patrol cycle (or the boot self-heal) and assert: the DB row is reconciled to the terminal verdict, the session is reaped, its agents row is flipped to stopped so countRunningAgents drops the slot — with no manual killSession outside the reaper. Scenario 2: a test agent stopped mid-stage (testStatus='testing', no live agent, no journaled/written verdict) → the test stage is re-dispatched. Per the repo rule use vi.useFakeTimers() + vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync() for the 10-min idle and 30s/60s throttle windows — never real waits. Mock tmux/session listing and the agents/review_status stores; do not spawn real sessions.

items.title: Given a review session alive with a journaled-but-unposted 'passed' verdict (DB row 'reviewing') idle >= 10 min, when one patrol cycle runs, then the DB is reconciled to 'passed', the session is reaped, and its agents row is flipped to stopped — no manual kill
Given a test agent stopped mid-stage with no verdict, when a patrol cycle runs, then the test stage is re-dispatched
Given the 10-min idle and throttle windows, when the test advances virtual time via fake timers, then the reconcile+reap assertions hold without real-time waits
